title: Emergency Plan Summary and Evacuation Drill Record
subtitle: Mossel Bay Cold Storage, Voorbaai depot. Plan reviewed March 2026; drill held 21 April 2026

blocks.p: This summary covers the Voorbaai depot (fictitious address: 8 Kaap Street, Voorbaai, Mossel Bay): two cold rooms, the blast freezer, the ammonia plant room, the loading dock and the office block. Usually 46 people are on site on day shift and 12 on night shift. The full plan, the site plan and the fire risk assessment are filed with this summary.

bullets: Fire in the office block, loading dock or plant room
Ammonia release from the refrigeration plant
Person trapped in a cold room or the blast freezer
Security emergency, including armed robbery at the dock

rows: Declares the emergency, calls emergency services, decides on evacuation, meets the fire brigade
Sweep their area, close doors, report to the assembly point
Give first aid; bring the first aid box and trauma kit to the assembly point
Shuts down the plant from outside the plant room; never enters without breathing apparatus and a second person
Brings the visitor and contractor register and the shift list; reports missing people to the controller
Front car park, next to the main gate, upwind of the plant room in the usual south westerly wind
When the controller announces that AP 1 is unsafe, for example an ammonia release drifting toward the car park
Fire brigade and local municipality emergency line
Number on the contact list at reception and in each marshal's file
Nearest hospital with an emergency unit
Named with directions on the contact list at reception
Radio channel 1; mobile numbers on the contact list
Callout number on the plant room door and the contact list
Panic buttons at reception and the dock office
Tuesday 21 April 2026, 10:15, day shift, announced to managers only
Simulated ammonia release in the plant room; controller moved everyone to AP 2
4 minutes 40 seconds from the alarm to the last marshal's report
Anele Jacobs and Refilwe Mahlangu, registered Health and Safety practitioner (fictitious)
Alarm not heard in cold room 2 with the fans running
Fit a flashing beacon and sounder inside cold room 2
Two visitors went to AP 1 because the change to AP 2 was not heard
Add AP 2 signs at both exits; marshals carry a loud hailer
Visitor register at reception was two names short
Security checks every visitor signs in at the gate before entry

blocks.p: Next drill: at the interval the emergency plan and the risk assessment set, on night shift so that the night team practises too.
